boundaries.note: 2026: Premier League bottom two relegated (Zhetysu, Kaisar); the First League's top two are promoted in a normal season. 2025 -> 2026 was a one-off 1 down / 3 up because the Premier League expanded from 14 to 16.

conflicts: The English 2026 Premier League article is tagged AI-generated and its attendance figure is meaningless, but its 16-team, 30-round, 240-match, 2-relegated shape matches the Russian Wikipedia article exactly, so the numbers are used.

Kazakhstan's second tier is variously called First League / First Division / Pervaya Liga; the Wikipedia article title is 'Kazakhstan First Division' while the league is 'Pervaya Liga'. Same competition.
notes: Calendar-year season (7 March - 31 October 2026). Premier League expanded from 14 to 16 for 2026 (30 rounds, 240 matches), with a one-off transition: only the 2025 bottom club was relegated and three First League clubs came up. From 2026 onward it is 2 up / 2 down. Two clubs were relegated in 2026 (Zhetysu, Kaisar). First League: 14 clubs, 26 rounds, top two promoted, bottom clubs relegated to the Second League (level 3, outside our data) - the exact number of Second League relegation places was not verified, so it is not encoded. The First League regularly includes reserve teams (e.g. Aktobe-2), which cannot be promoted and would need filtering in a sim.
